summary_1line: Sumantra is sent to summon Rama while Ayodhya prepares lavishly for his coronation, unaware of the impending tragedy.

image_candidates.scene_text: Golden vessels filled with sacred waters and lotus blooms are arranged around a tiger-skin throne as priests prepare Rama’s coronation ceremony.
Sumantra rides his chariot through flag-lined streets of joyful Ayodhya toward Rama’s gleaming palace, bright as Mount Kailasha.
At Rama’s palace gate, kings, priests, musicians, elephants, and richly dressed attendants wait with gifts beneath banners and jewel-studded decorations.
